# filename: search_ams_items.py
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import re

items = [
    "dried apples", "dried apricots", "dried peaches", "dried pears", "prunes",
    "raisins", "dried figs", "dehydrated onions", "dehydrated garlic",
    "dehydrated carrots", "dehydrated celery", "dehydrated potatoes",
    "dehydrated spinach", "dehydrated sweetpotatoes",
    "frozen apples", "frozen apricots", "frozen peaches", "frozen pears",
    "frozen prunes", "frozen onions", "frozen potatoes", "frozen carrots",
    "frozen spinach"
]

base = "https://www.ams.usda.gov/search?search_api_fulltext={q}&f[0]=field_document_type%3Astandards"

def find_years_for_item(item):
    url = base.format(q=item.replace(" ", "+"))
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        return []
    soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, "html.parser")
    years = []
    for div in soup.select("div.search-result"):
        txt = " ".join([div.get_text(separator=" ", strip=True)]).lower()
        years += [int(y) for y in re.findall(r"19\d{2}|20\d{2}", txt)]
    return sorted(set(years))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for item in items:
        ys = find_years_for_item(item)
        print(f"{item}: {ys}")
